a_trap_avoided: the first attempt to read these headers returned nothing because dist/include/nss holds symlinks into /build/... that dangle; the survey was redone against security/nss/lib, the same resolution used for brotli and for R358
consequence: OCSP is the only revocation mechanism reachable from this adapter without rebuilding NSS with changed visibility
not_done: nothing was wired; no OCSP responder was contacted; no revocation state was enforced; the online responder requirement makes this a larger piece of work than a decode path
why_the_last_row_matters: a symbol can appear in the headers and still be absent from the dynamic export table; CERT_CheckCRL is declared in cert.h but nm finds no definition in libnss3.so, so a CRL check cannot be linked against this build
